title: Alaska Northern Outfitters
specs: M/V Sea Quest catamaran designed for comfort, speed, and stability
Only vessel in Seward with an upper deck for breaks and photography
Owner-operated since 2003 with experience since the 1970s
Space to accommodate 34 indoor seats; suitable for large groups, weddings, and company trips
includes: Indoor heated cabin with seating for all passengers
Upper observation deck for photography and viewing
High performance tournament tackle (Okuma Makaira 16 reels and Seeker Alaska Series rods)
Fish handling and cleaning aboard the vessel
blurb: Guests fish for halibut, salmon, and rockfish on full-day charters aboard the M/V Sea Quest, a catamaran designed for comfort and speed. The vessel features an indoor heated cabin with seating for all passengers, an upper observation deck, and high-performance tournament tackle. Fish are handled and cleaned aboard, with options for local processing, packaging, freezing, and shipping.

quotes.text: These folks exceeded our expectations in costumer service from booking to filleting at the end of the day! Captain Sean and Deckhand Jed were excellent…kind, great attitudes, knowledgeable, and always making sure we were baited & getting lines down! Thank you for a great start to the fishing season, can’t wait to book again!

Hands down the best charter I have been on. This is the fourth charter I have been on in AK and probably 20th I've been on in my life. Capt Sean and his guys were funny, tentative, professional, respectful, and hard working.

What an amazing trip! Captain Sean and his crew did a phenomenal job. We all limited out on halibut, rock fish and a lot of people caught silvers as well. The boat was clean, big, fast, and it had a bathroom.

I'm a lifelong Alaskan and have been on a lot of fishing charters. This may be the best one I've been on. Great boat and even greater crew. The boat is big and fast. Gets you out to the best fish fast.
